headline: 3 injured in Gandaria shooting
summary: A woman and two men were hit by indiscriminate gunfire in the capital's Gandaria area on Sunday evening.
details: Three people, including a woman, were injured after gunmen opened fire indiscriminately in the Swamibagh Munsirtek area of Gandaria, Dhaka, on Sunday evening around 7 PM.
The injured have been identified as Asha Akter (20), Alamgir (33), and Siyam (18). They were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) for treatment.
According to Inspector Mo. Faruk, in-charge of the DMCH police camp, Siyam was shot in the left side of his chest, Alamgir in the head, and Asha Akter in the right leg.
The victims claimed they were simply pedestrians and local business owners in the area when the attack occurred.
Gandaria police stated that the incident may have been triggered by a dispute over drug turf wars. Legal action is currently underway, and the situation in the area has returned to normal.
caption:
Three people, including a woman, and a teenager, were hit by indiscriminate gunfire in Dhaka's Gandaria.

Three people, including a woman, were injured after gunmen opened fire indiscriminately in the Swamibagh Munsirtek area of Gandaria, Dhaka, on Sunday evening around 7 PM.

The injured have been identified as Asha Akter (20), Alamgir (33), and Siyam (18). They were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) for treatment.

According to Inspector Mo. Faruk, in-charge of the DMCH police camp, Siyam was shot in the left side of his chest, Alamgir in the head, and Asha Akter in the right leg.

The victims claimed they were simply pedestrians and local business owners in the area when the attack occurred.

Gandaria police stated that the incident may have been triggered by a dispute over drug turf wars. Legal action is currently underway, and the situation in the area has returned to normal.

headline: 2 arrested after teacher killed in snatching attempt near parliament
summary: RAB-2 has detained two suspects in the murder of Ronjina Parveen, though discrepancies in the recovered motorcycle have raised questions.
details: RAB-2 has arrested two suspects, Mosharraf Hossain Pony (alias 'Para Pony') and his associate Cedric, in connection with the murder of teacher Ronjina Parveen.
The arrests took place during a special operation in the East Tejturi Bazar area of Tejgaon, Dhaka.
Law enforcement officials also seized a motorcycle used in the crime and have taken the bike's owner, Rakib, into custody for questioning.
During the arrest, the primary suspect, Para Pony, denied any involvement in the killing.
Questions have emerged regarding the recovered motorcycle, as its color reportedly differs from the one seen in CCTV footage of the incident.
Investigating sources stated that the seized evidence and footage are being thoroughly scrutinized to resolve these discrepancies.
Following an autopsy, Ronjina Parveen's body was taken to her home in Bogura, where she was buried in the family graveyard.
caption:
Two suspects are in custody after a teacher was killed during a snatching attempt in Dhaka, but a mismatch in evidence is raising questions.

RAB-2 has arrested two suspects, Mosharraf Hossain Pony (alias 'Para Pony') and his associate Cedric, in connection with the murder of teacher Ronjina Parveen.

The arrests took place during a special operation in the East Tejturi Bazar area of Tejgaon, Dhaka.

Law enforcement officials also seized a motorcycle used in the crime and have taken the bike's owner, Rakib, into custody for questioning.

During the arrest, the primary suspect, Para Pony, denied any involvement in the killing.

Questions have emerged regarding the recovered motorcycle, as its color reportedly differs from the one seen in CCTV footage of the incident.

Investigating sources stated that the seized evidence and footage are being thoroughly scrutinized to resolve these discrepancies.

Following an autopsy, Ronjina Parveen's body was taken to her home in Bogura, where she was buried in the family graveyard.
